main_text.p: næ sunt, & oleo isto affuso; crescunt quidem, sed non satiantur. Et certè solus ad decipiendum Cupiditas, quam Sensus valet: imo nihil hic ad præstiorias valet sine cantu istius Sirenis: Quidvis enim Sensus exhibeat, non decipiemur, nisi stimulet nos & inducat proclivitas quædam & velut libido credendi; Atqui hæc non aliò referri, quam ad Cupiditatem potest. Proclivitas hæc impotentia quædam est, luxuries & animi profusio, qua quod nostrum est, jactamus, & in alios temerè prodigimus: Dnquam, Sensuum nostrorum perceptiones, quæ nobis propriæ sunt, in causas a quibus excitantur, transferimus: Et, cum v.g. paries iste sic affectus, talem in nobis sensum causet, quo, cum fruimur, album colorem nos videre dicimus, ipsum illi parieti seusum ascribentes, id eum in se habere judicamus, quod in nobis, ut haberemus, effecit: Sic

page.notes: The left margin fragment is cut off by the scan edge and too faint to transcribe reliably; not transcribed. Some words in the first lines are partly obscured by the binding shadow. "præstiorias" is printed across a line break as "præsti-/rias" and is joined here. "Dnquam" is the printed initial D with a possible misprint; the rendering is doubtful. The final word "Sic" is a catchword-like signature line set at the right and is kept as the last line of text.
